notes.title: 🏛️ 2028 Expansion Out Now — 50% Off!
notes.notes:
[h1]🏛️ 2028 Expansion Out Now — 50% Off! 🗳️[/h1]

Prepare your campaign. The stakes have never been higher.

[b]The all-new "2028 Mission"[/b] is here, and it's our most challenging update yet. A new mode puts you in the chaos of the 2028 elections, where:
[list]
[*] Difficulty is vastly increased
[*] You start each level with a random weapon
[*] Strategic adaptability is the only way to survive
[*] Brute force is the only way 
[/list]

Also included:
✅ [b]New achievement added (Empty hands)[/b]
✅ [b]Grace of God achievement fixed[/b]

[h2]💥 To celebrate the update, the game is now [b]50% OFF[/b]![/h2]
Whether you're a seasoned candidate or a first-time fighter, there's never been a better time to jump in.
